common.recordedByPaperclip: Recorded by Paperclip — entries can't be edited. Sensitive values are never stored.

audit.description: What your agents actually did with your apps, newest first. Each line is one decision — allowed, blocked, asked first, waiting, or failed.
audit.emptyFilteredHint: Try a wider time window or different filters.
audit.emptyHint: As soon as your agents start using connected apps, what they do shows up here.
audit.runReceivedNoServers: {{agent}}'s run received 0 MCP servers — {{count}} permitted {{connectionWord}} not installed

reasons.permittedNotInstalled: Permitted connections were not installed, so their tools were not added to this run.
reasons.blockedRateLimited: Blocked because it ran too many times in a short window.
reasons.blockedSecret: Blocked to keep a sensitive value from leaving.
reasons.askedFirst: Held for someone to approve before it could run.
reasons.waiting: Waiting — the app it needs wasn't ready yet.
reasons.failed: The app was allowed to run it, but returned an error.

runtime.description: How your apps are doing right now.

summary.appsStartOnNeed: Apps start when an agent first needs them
summary.noCallsLastHour: No calls in the last hour
summary.errorBreakdown: {{failures}} failed · {{timeouts}} timed out · {{deferrals}} waited for capacity

stuckStarting.title: An app is stuck starting up
stuckStarting.body: It began starting but never came online. Restarting usually clears this.

stoppedResponding.title: An app stopped responding
stoppedResponding.body: The process is still running but isn't answering. Restarting usually clears this.

slow.title: Apps are responding slowly
slow.body: Some actions are timing out ({{observed}}). Check the apps involved or try again shortly.

errors.title: Apps are failing more than usual
errors.body: Recent actions failed after they were allowed ({{observed}}).

capacity.title: Too many apps running at once
capacity.body: Some actions had to wait for a free slot ({{observed}}).

restartStorm.title: An app keeps restarting
restartStorm.body: It has restarted repeatedly ({{observed}}). It may be misconfigured or offline.

reconnect.title: An app needs reconnecting
reconnect.body: A connected app isn't healthy. Open it to check the key or reconnect.

missingKey.title: An app is missing a key
missingKey.body: A saved key couldn't be found, so some actions failed. Reconnect the app to fix it.

auditFailure.title: Activity logging hit a problem
auditFailure.body: Some actions may not have been recorded. This needs an administrator to look into it.

runtime.noAppsRunningHint: Apps that run on this machine start automatically the first time an agent needs them. Apps that connect over the internet don't use a local process.
runtime.rowHint: Click a row to see how the connection is wired up.
runtime.providerSideHint: This app runs on the provider's side — there's nothing to stop or restart here.
runtime.offHint: This app is off. It will start again when an agent needs it.
runtime.remoteHint: Apps that "connect over the internet" hide Stop and Restart — those run on the provider's side, so there's no local process to control here.

confirm.restartBody: Anything in progress will stop. Agents using {{name}} right now will see a Failed result on their action.
confirm.stopBody: {{name}} will stop running. Agents won't be able to use it until it starts again.
confirm.stopHint: It starts again automatically the next time an agent needs it.

feed.enterpriseTitle: Agent audit is a Paperclip Enterprise view
feed.enterpriseBody: The agent audit log gives you a searchable, exportable record of everything your agents did — every comment, task change, approval, and run — with the responsible person for each action. Ask an administrator to grant you the audit:view_agent_actions permission to view it.
feed.couldNotExport: Could not export the audit log.
feed.agentDescription: Every recorded agent action, newest first — with the responsible person and run behind each one.
feed.companyDescription: Everything happening in your company, newest first — people, agents, and the system. Each line is one recorded action.
feed.tryWider: Try a wider date range or different filters.
feed.agentsAppear: As soon as your agents start doing things, their actions show up here.
feed.companyAppears: As soon as anyone in your company does something, it shows up here.
feed.failedLoad: Failed to load the audit log.
